name: Niche single-function utility/calculator sites
one_liner: Build simple single-purpose web tools, like word unscramblers or niche calculators, that pull search traffic and earn from display ads.
customer: Display ad networks pay for the traffic; the users are word-game players, side hustlers, contractors and health hobbyists searching for a quick tool
offer: Free web utilities: word unscrambler, syllable counter, estimated-tax calculator, paint coverage or concrete yardage calculators, fasting calculator
how_it_makes_money: Display advertising on high-volume organic traffic; can grow into a portfolio of sites
startup_cost: low (domain + hosting; can be built with AI)
time_to_first_revenue: unknown; SEO traffic usually takes months
evidence: wordunscrambler.me estimated at 2-8M monthly visits, built in 2014; 'estimates range as high as five or six million dollars a year' (Wvwt9CB6uKI)
Portfolio combined is around 17 million monthly visitors (Wvwt9CB6uKI)
Intermittent fasting calculator 'making a reported $400 a month and very clearly built with AI' (Wvwt9CB6uKI)
A '$30,000 a year side hustle' is mentioned as one of the examples (Wvwt9CB6uKI)
risks: Google algorithm and AI-search changes can wipe out traffic
Revenue figures are third-party estimates
Popular niches are saturated; you need to find long-tail ones
Slow ramp before ad revenue becomes meaningful

name: Localised calculator/tool sites for UK and Portuguese niches
one_liner: Apply the utility-site model to UK and Portugal-specific calculations that US-focused tool builders don't cover.
customer: Ad networks and affiliate partners; users are UK side hustlers, landlords and expats moving between the UK and Portugal
offer: Calculators such as UK side-hustle tax / self-assessment estimators, Portuguese IRS or NHR-type estimators, and tradesperson material calculators in metric units and in Portuguese
how_it_makes_money: Display ads, plus affiliate links (accountants, banks, tax software)
evidence: The host built a 'side hustle income tax calculator, estimated tax calculator' with AI after asking it for ideas (Wvwt9CB6uKI)
AI suggested contractor tools such as a 'paint coverage calculator by room dimensions, a concrete yardage calculator' (Wvwt9CB6uKI)
Weak evidence: localisation is an extrapolation; no UK or PT revenue data in the transcript
risks: Smaller search volumes than US English
Tax tools carry accuracy and liability risk and need disclaimers
SEO dependency

name: Shared-postcard local advertising (direct mail co-op)
one_liner: Sell ad slots on one shared postcard mailed to local households, with deals closed over Messenger or text.
customer: Local service businesses (plumbers, trades, restaurants, etc.)
offer: An advertising spot on a shared direct-mail postcard sent to a target area
how_it_makes_money: A per-slot ad fee; one plumber paid $1,100; about 50% profit margin after print and postage
time_to_first_revenue: weeks (first cards sent without even an LLC)
tools: print-and-mail service (e.g. Royal Mail Door to Door in the UK)
evidence: 'You turned a $90 investment into $50,000 in a year. On the side.' (Y4pvrjtb1cI)
'I probably closed 95% of my deals over messenger or text' with no calls (Y4pvrjtb1cI)
'One plumber even paid him $1,100 after five texts. He pockets about half of everything he collects as profit.' (Y4pvrjtb1cI)
risks: UK print and postage costs and Royal Mail logistics differ from the US
You must fill every slot before printing, so there is cash-flow and coordination risk
Revenue is tied to geography, so scaling means repeating the process area by area
Advertisers churn if they don't get results

name: Raw land wholesaling via direct mail
one_liner: Mail offers to owners of cheap rural land, get contracts signed, then assign or resell to builders or buyers at a margin.
customer: Land buyers, builders and developers (the sellers are often absentee owners)
offer: Off-market land deals sourced by mailing offers
how_it_makes_money: Spread or assignment fee, about 10% margin (~$8,600 average per deal); the founders' best month was 37 deals and $532k profit
startup_cost: low to medium (mailing costs; 'iPhone, internet connection' to start)
evidence: 'Our best month that we ever did was 37 deals and $532,000 in profit' (_1DziIwKyGk)
'We've done over 100,000 a month for the last 40 months straight' (_1DziIwKyGk)
Four lots bought for $37k made about $140k (_1DziIwKyGk)
Signed contracts came back by mail with no conversation with the seller (_1DziIwKyGk)
risks: A US-specific model; UK planning and conveyancing rules make wholesaling much harder
Running it remotely in the US means legal and title complexity
Survivorship bias in the case study
Some US states regulate wholesaling

name: AI trend-spotting agent for first-mover content
one_liner: Run an AI agent that tracks trending topics in a niche so you publish first, then monetise the audience or sell the briefs.
customer: Your own audience (ads or sponsors), or creators and brands paying for trend briefs
offer: Fast niche news and analysis content, or a paid trend-alert newsletter
how_it_makes_money: Content monetisation or sponsorships; possibly a newsletter subscription (not stated)
startup_cost: low (VPS hosting + LLM API key; ~$6 extra for a preconfigured setup)
evidence: Weak evidence: the claim that the first creator to cover a new study gets 10M views versus 2M for the second is hypothetical (XQJWYvbAaOg)
Setup with 'no per agent fee, no coding involved' (XQJWYvbAaOg)
risks: No revenue case shown; this is mostly a tool walkthrough
Being first doesn't guarantee distribution
Easy to copy

name: Sponsored content business on a niche audience
one_liner: Build a niche audience on one platform, then sell sponsored posts and your own products.
customer: Brands buying sponsorships; audience members buying products
offer: Sponsored posts, TikTok Shop products, books or events
how_it_makes_money: About $2,000-7,000 per sponsored post at 100k followers (as stated); product sales
time_to_first_revenue: unknown; typically months to build an audience
evidence: 'You can charge anywhere from 2[,000-]7,000 per sponsored post if you have 100,000 followers' (ZvAwqGH_79Q)
With over 2M TikTok followers she 'sold less than a dozen tickets' to her last event, so reach doesn't equal sales (ZvAwqGH_79Q)
risks: Slow audience build
Platform dependency
Weak conversion from social reach to sales
